svg.title: Import tickets from a CSV — SoftTrack web design mockup (#314)
svg.desc: SoftTrack imports from Jira and from nothing else, and its own CSV export cannot be read back in. A team admin uploads a CSV, matches its columns to fields and its values to statuses, priorities, types and labels, sees a preview and a dry run, and imports; an external key keeps each row’s identity so that importing again duplicates nothing.
svg.text: · from any tool that exports one
An export in CSV, and somewhere to put it

g.text: Engineering → Import, signed in as Amina, a team admin
From Trello, Asana, Linear, GitHub Issues, a spreadsheet, or SoftTrack’s own export.
The same for priorities, types and labels.
and every row that cannot be read
due date “next week” is not a date
parent trl-000 is not in the file
THE SAME FILE, A SECOND TIME
Imported tickets send no notifications and fire no automation rules,
as with the Jira import. Parents are set after every row exists.

svg.text: Done when a team admin can upload a CSV, match columns to fields with guesses corrected by hand, match values or create them, see a preview and every unreadable row with
its reason, run dry and then import in one transaction per batch; external_key makes a second import update and not duplicate; assignees not on the team are left unassigned and
listed; SoftTrack’s own export is a layout it reads; and imported tickets send no notifications and fire no automation.
